purpose: Small synthetic controlled evaluation set; not a representative benchmark.

review.limitation: Project owner reviewed and approved the case/policy draft. Labels are single-reviewer annotations and should be treated as exploratory, not independently adjudicated ground truth.

notes: The cases are synthetic and hand-authored; they do not contain HaluMem content.
required_claims are verifier inputs; expected decisions/findings/affected IDs are stored in the separate labels file.
Graph and text currently use the same deterministic verification logic. This manifest can test pipeline parity, not graph superiority.
Development fixtures in membud.demo are separate and are not part of this manifest.
